_comment: vutaz uzky. Aero from XFLR5 (_aero_source, _clmax_source); empty mass, cruise speed and drag articles from the team (2026-10-28); the other takeoff/mission values are still the illustrative defaults. Masses exclude payload and propulsion parts.
name: vutaz uzky

drag_articles._comment: 2x Flying Pig + 1x Waffle, entered as 3 equal articles with the average mass and CdA (totals exact: 0.9072 kg, CdA 0.0521 m2). Rule minimum weights (lb): pig 0.75, waffle 0.50. CdA = drag / (0.5 * 1.225 * 15^2) from pareto+symetryScore.xlsx 'Model assumptions' (drag at 15 m/s): pig 1.34 N -> 0.00972 m2, waffle 4.50 N -> 0.03265 m2.

_clmax_source.basis: trimmed, ~8% static margin (CG ~0.36 m behind root LE), elevon up to 15 deg
_clmax_source.method: XFLR5 spanload (vutaz.xfl opps, alpha 0-11, extrapolated) vs XFoil section clmax (N9, by local Re); elevon increments from a vortex lattice incl. tip fins (matches XFLR5 CL_alpha within 2.5%, NP within 3 mm)
_clmax_source.assumed_elevons: y 0.26-0.72 m, 25% chord, 0.8 x thin-airfoil effectiveness; up-elevon lowers section clmax by 0.6 x its dcl0
_clmax_source.note: XFLR5 station at y=0.2195 m (kink) is a panelling spike and was excluded
